title: LayerNorm and RMSNorm
summary: LayerNorm with gamma and beta and RMSNorm with a weight, both over the last axis, with eps inside the square root.

mutants.ignores_eps_argument: Uses a fixed eps of 1e-5 in LayerNorm and ignores the eps that the caller passes.
mutants.mean_over_batch_axis: Takes the LayerNorm mean over axis 0, not over the last axis.
mutants.rms_eps_outside_sqrt: Adds eps after the square root in RMSNorm.
mutants.rms_subtracts_mean: Uses the variance in RMSNorm, so it subtracts the mean as LayerNorm does.
mutants.unbiased_variance: Uses the unbiased variance with D - 1 in LayerNorm.
